about_the_game:
“When all the planets in the galaxy succumb to the mysterious forces, only the most powerful of wizards can save their inhabitants and face the great evil behind this destruction. Resting in the crystal fields of Cristalia, the mighty Zavior is called back to action and is ready to face all types of danger to protect these innocent lives… or at least try.”

Wizavior is a 3D platformer game with arcade aspects, such as time based stages and an endless game mode game. With a fun narrative and memorable characters, you player will take the role of the mighty-but-retired wizard Zavior in a quest throughout multiple planets. Save each planet's inhabitants by collecting Energy Crystals that power up Zavior's powerful Spells!

  • Challenging platform mechanics; 

  • Five unique planets to save + epic final challenge;

  • Weird aliens that you’ll grow to love;

  • Visually beautiful & strong narrative;

  • Unique and engaging soundtrack; 

  • Evolving HUB that changes during the story;

  • Compelling story with more than 30 minutes of frame-by-frame animated cutscenes;

  • Collectables and achievements;

STORY MODE:

  • Help the wizard Zavior in his saga to save the inhabitants of Planets doomed to destruction!

  • 5 Unique scenarios with multiple levels that have its unique set of hazards and challenges! + An epic final encounter!

  • A total of 33 different levels!

  • 3-5 hours of gameplay 

  • More than 30 minutes of 2D animated cutscenes

ARCADE MODE:

  • An endless sequence of stages

  • Increasing difficulty progression

  • A classic test of game and controls skill!

  • Scoreboard to keep track of your best runs!

Collect crystals scattered throughout the game and exchange them for a wide variety of rewards, including concept art, intricate statuettes, and many other unique items. These collectibles will not only enhance your in-game experience but also enrich your personal collection, offering you a deeper connection to the world and the characters within it. Each item serves as a memento of your journey, providing you with new ways to explore the game's artistry and lore.

Meet the planets:

Cristalia: Wizavior’s home planet works as a HUB for all the aliens that you rescue! Explore your home planet and interact with the rescued aliens. You’ll see changes inside your house and on the planet as you progress and through the story.

Aurar: Completely made of ice, Aurar is known for its constant heavy snow storms and for being home to the fierce, terrible and cruel creatures that dwell in the shadows of the caves. At least that's what they say.

Deliria: With huge tornadoes and strong sandstorms, it is the perfect home for the delirians that inhabit it. Tornado surfing is the local favorite sport. Or is it the mirage hunt? Or the jump on the sand? Ahnn... You tell me.

Phyto: The entire ecosystem of Phyto revolves around the Giant Bonsai that is cared for by its small and countless inhabitants. Phytonians are famous for their pollen inspiring the creation of the most colorful programs on the Universal Television Network.

Xoferasta: The inhabitants of Xoferasta venerate the Planet, which is entirely formed by active volcanoes. The xoferastian civilization inhabits both the outside and the inside of volcanoes and bathes in the molten lava rivers that cut across the Planet.

ABOUT SPLIT STUDIO

Since 2009, Split has established itself as an award-winning animation and gaming studio. We create content in various formats for clients such as Cartoon Network, Mauricio de Sousa Produções, Cartoonito, Disney Junior, Sanrio, Instituto Ayrton Senna, Canal Futura, Riot Games and many others. Our original projects are treated as intellectual properties: we don’t see them merely as series, films, or games, but as 360º content that can expand across multiple media platforms. This includes works like WeeBoom, Tekoha: A Tale Among The Stars, Boomies, and, of course, Wizavior.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200 / Intel® Core™ i3-8100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050 4GB / AMD Radeon™ RX 560 4GB
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 2600X / Intel® Core™ i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: 3D platformer that will pull you into a whirlwind of adventure! Step into the shoes of the titular Wizavior—a retired wizard who, with humor and determination, sets out once again to save the world from evil.
